title: Pages in nested Frames and in the Frame cache (rows 13, 14)

setup.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<Page
    x:Class="TodoBench.InnerPage"
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
        <TextBlock x:Name="InnerText" />
        <TextBlock x:Name="InnerMark" Text="mark-v1" />
        <Button x:Name="InnerNext" Content="Next" Click="OnNext" />
    </StackPanel>
</Page>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<Page
    x:Class="TodoBench.DetailsPage"
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
    NavigationCacheMode="Required">
    <StackPanel Padding="12" Spacing="8">
        <TextBlock x:Name="DetailsText" Text="details-v1" />
        <TextBlock x:Name="DetailsParam" />
        <Button x:Name="BackButton" Content="Back" Click="OnBack" />
    </StackPanel>
</Page>

steps.title: A page kept in the Frame cache (NavigationCacheMode Required, not shown) is edited: shown again, it has the change
The page shown after a navigation is edited: same parameter, and Back still goes back
The page hosting a nested Frame is rebuilt: the nested Frame shows the page it showed, with its parameter
The page in the nested Frame is edited: only it is rebuilt, with its parameter
